<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant peak at ~199 and a nearly equal intensity peak at ~201 (M+2), which is the characteristic 1:1 pattern of a single bromine atom. No other element shows a distinctive isotopic pattern (e.g., chlorine’s 3:1, sulfur’s low‑abundance M+2). Therefore, bromine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
